# CANDIDATE: MIDDAY_VWAP_MEAN_REVERSION

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After the morning rush, price often reverts to intraday VWAP when deviated beyond one ATR, especially when RSI shows exhaustion and volume is fading. This strategy fades extended deviations from VWAP with exhaustion filters, contrasting with existing VWAP_CONTINUATION which trades with momentum.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: After 11:30 EST, if |close - VWAP| > 1 * ATR(14) AND RSI(14) > 70 (short) or < 30 (long) AND volume of the current bar < average volume of the prior 10 bars, then enter opposite direction (short if overbought, long if oversold) at the close of that bar. Exit shape: Stop at the recent swing point (high of last 5 bars for short, low for long); TP1 at 0.5R (target VWAP); if price reaches VWAP, allow runner with trailing stop using premium‑stop 10% of ATR. Regime hint: Optimal when VIX between 15‑25 and time 11:30‑13:30 EST; avoid first and last 30 minutes of session.
